title: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: The old vampire-demon leader of the Maestros and curator of its museum, who sends Anhelo to the Crescendo and is killed by the Adversary.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: Xander's general in the Maestros, whom Xander names as his future successor.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: The demon planeswalker called the Adversary, who has infiltrated every family, kills Xander and launches a coup at the Crescendo.

entities.name: Elspeth Tyrel
entities.description: A planeswalker who infiltrated the Cabaretti for Xander and flees the Crescendo protecting Giada, becoming a target of the Adversary.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker archer who rescues Elspeth and Giada with spectral wolves and a dragon and brings news Elspeth wants to hear.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: A young woman, kept by the Cabaretti, who creates Halo from nothing by touching a bottle; she is exhausted, trapped, and flees with Elspeth.

entities.name: Jinnie Fay
entities.description: Adoptive daughter of Jetmir and his right hand in the Cabaretti, who tends Giada and announces the Font at the Crescendo.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: The horned leonin who rules the Cabaretti and is gravely wounded in the attack.

entities.name: Kitt
entities.description: A Cabaretti performer who works with Jinnie.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The plane of the city-wide crime families, where the Crescendo takes place.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: The vampire crime family led by Xander, many of whose members have been turned to the Adversary.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: The family led by Jetmir that guards the Font and hosts the Crescendo.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: A family that has retreated into the shadows under attack.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: A family that has crawled into its holes under attack.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: A family reported thoroughly compromised by the Adversary.

entities.name: The Crescendo
entities.description: The yearly gathering of the families, held at the Vantoleone, where the Cabaretti unveil the Font and the Adversary launches his attack.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A potent magic substance of New Capenna that Giada creates from nothing.

entities.name: The Vantoleone
entities.description: The theater where the Crescendo is held.

entities.name: Maestros' Museum
entities.description: Xander's museum in Park Heights, which he built and curates; it is overrun by the Adversary's loyalists.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The top level of the city, where the Maestros' museum stands.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The middle level of the city, through which Elspeth, Vivien and Giada flee.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: The lowest level of the city, where fighting is hot.

events.summary: On the eve of the Crescendo, Xander walks the museum one last time, names Anhelo his heir and orders him to go to the Crescendo in his place.
events.quote: "But someday soon, you will be."

events.summary: Xander sends Anhelo out the receiving door, sensing enemies are close, and then confronts the Adversary in the shadows.
events.quote: "Have you finally come to kill me, Adversary?"

events.summary: Elspeth works the floor at the Crescendo, where Jinnie, Kitt and Giada approach her.
events.quote: Elspeth stood on the dance floor of the Vantoleone with a platter in hand.

events.summary: Jinnie leads Giada onstage as Maestros begin to move through the crowd, and Elspeth senses something wrong.
events.quote: Something was wrong.

events.summary: Giada touches an enormous empty bottle and it fills with Halo, which Jinnie presents as the Font, Halo made from nothing.
events.quote: we have made Halo from nothing .

events.summary: Elspeth realizes the cost: the Cabaretti's new era will cost the exhausted, trapped Giada her life.
events.quote: Their "new era" would come at the cost of Giada's life.

events.summary: Xander's former assassins turn on him in the museum and he kills several with his cane-blade before retreating.
events.quote: Xander grabbed it, slashing through the air and sending a spray of ash across the room.

events.summary: Xander flees to the viewing deck and duels the Adversary, who lands behind him.
events.quote: "Did you really think you could escape me?"

events.summary: The Adversary blasts Xander with magic and Xander falls from Park Heights into the clouds below.
events.quote: His foot met open air, and he plummeted into the clouds below.

events.summary: The Adversary's infiltrators reveal themselves at the Crescendo; revelers throw off their family signets and draw weapons, and the Halo bottle is dropped.
events.quote: No family was exempt from infiltration by the Adversary.

events.summary: Jinnie abandons Giada on stage to rush to Jetmir, who is cornered and outnumbered.
events.quote: Jinnie leapt into the fray, weapons drawn, leaving Giada behind.

events.summary: Elspeth fights through the chaos, defeats the Adversary's loyalists on stage and offers to take Giada away.
events.quote: "Would you like me to take you from here?"

events.summary: Elspeth and Giada flee through the wings and a back door, killing pursuers along the way.
events.quote: when her dagger sank into a man's gut with a gurgle, she knew she was right.

events.summary: In the alley, Vivien appears and kills the Adversary's goons with spectral wolves; Elspeth vouches for her to Giada.
events.quote: "Vivien's an ally; she can be trusted."

events.summary: Jinnie, Jetmir and Cabaretti emerge and demand Giada be brought to them; Elspeth, sensing Giada's wishes, refuses.
events.quote: "Bring Giada to me."

events.summary: Vivien conjures a spectral dragon to block Jinnie, and the three flee into the night.
events.quote: the loops of a scaled dragon filled the alleyway.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis revels over Xander's mutilated body, and a Maestro informs him that the Font escaped the Crescendo.
events.quote: "The Font escaped."

events.summary: Ob Nixilis learns another unaccounted person aided the escape, realizes Xander played him, and vows to find the Font.
events.quote: Even from beyond the grave, Xander had played him.

events.summary: Officers report Jetmir gravely wounded, the Cabaretti neutralized and other families compromised; Ob Nixilis orders the families' heads and a hunt for the Font.
events.quote: "I want the families' heads. All of them.

events.summary: Elspeth, Vivien and Giada flee across the Mezzio; Elspeth decides to retrieve a better weapon from the Maestros' museum.
events.quote: "I need a better weapon than a knife.

events.summary: Elspeth finds the museum overrun, overhears that she is the Adversary's target number one, and takes a sword from the armory.
events.quote: "The Adversary has deemed her as target number one

relations.quote: The mighty head of the Maestros, the infamous Xander, master assassin .

relations.note: Xander's general, and his intended successor.
relations.quote: Xander could feel his general's confusion as he followed Xander about the museum.

relations.note: Blasts Xander off the balcony and mutilates his body.
relations.quote: The mighty head of the Maestros, the infamous Xander, master assassin .

relations.note: Adoptive daughter and right hand of Jetmir.
relations.quote: the adoptive daughter of Jetmir and his right hand

relations.note: The horned leonin who rules the Cabaretti.
relations.quote: the horned leonin who ruled the Cabaretti

relations.note: Took missions from Xander and was given his knife.
relations.quote: the knife Xander had given her

relations.note: Protects Giada from the Cabaretti and the Adversary.
relations.quote: "Would you like me to take you from here?"

relations.note: Elspeth vouches for Vivien as an ally.
relations.quote: "Vivien's an ally; she can be trusted."

relations.note: The Adversary has marked her as his primary target.
relations.quote: "The Adversary has deemed her as target number one

relations.note: She is the Font, held by the Cabaretti.
relations.quote: She was giving her life for the Cabaretti and their Halo.

relations.note: His loyalists attack the Cabaretti and cripple Jetmir.
